test: keeps strict edit boundaries, target tracks and finite gap extents
contract: Next/previous boundaries are strictly after/before the query; targets limit candidates; gaps include frame zero but stop at the final clip.
bug: Keyboard navigation lands on the current cut, ignores audio/targets, or hit-testing exposes an unbounded trailing gap.
oracle: Authored literal previous/next tables and exact [0,5), [20,30) gaps, independently of model scans.
seam: Public nextEditPoint/prevEditPoint/gapAt functions consumed by transport.ts, ComparisonView.tsx and timeline hit-testing.
refactor: Checks returned public values/state; no private collaborator, call-count, cache-key or storage-layout assertions.
unique: The generated property covers broad shapes; this owner pins exact boundary convention, empty/missing targets and audio inclusion without implementation-derived expectations.
reason: Replaced helper-derived expectations with literal results; removed nonfinite synthetic query combinations without a specified navigation result.

test: sees changed clip versions, undo-like reuse and edits inside an Immer draft
contract: Queries must read a changed immutable clip version, then read the original version correctly after undo.
bug: Go To Edit or gap hit-testing uses a stale index after an edit or undo.
oracle: Literal next/previous values 30/5 for changed clips, 20/10 for restored clips, and exact gap boundaries.
seam: Public query functions over committed immutable Sequence values.
refactor: Checks returned public values/state; no private collaborator, call-count, cache-key or storage-layout assertions.
unique: Only this case switches versions and revisits the original for the three query APIs. In-transaction draft-index validity is owned by derive-draft-index.test.ts through real document commands.
reason: Removed private in-draft cache probes: actual navigation/hit-test callers read committed sequences. Kept edit/undo output regression at the caller boundary.
replacementTest: reads changed clip versions and a previous version restored by undo

test: agrees with the full boundary and gap scans on non-overlapping generated tracks
contract: For each valid non-overlapping track layout, next=min(boundaries>frame), previous=max(boundaries<frame); gaps are empty connected intervals from zero to the last clip.
bug: Binary lookup skips a cut/gap for a larger or uneven track layout, or includes an untargeted track.
oracle: Independent set extrema and occupancy of adjacent endpoint intervals, not the removed production cursor walk.
seam: Public nextEditPoint/prevEditPoint/gapAt output for generated sequence values.
refactor: Checks returned public values/state; no private collaborator, call-count, cache-key or storage-layout assertions.
unique: All 75 seeded scenarios and every boundary ±0.5 plus random query positions survive; literal cases do not cover every generated layout.
reason: Replaced copied procedural scan oracle with interval mathematics. Batches complete result vectors into fewer assertions, preserving every query and deterministic seed while eliminating repeated assertion/sort setup.
replacementTest: obeys nearest-boundary and empty-interval definitions on generated tracks
